home.heading:
Light, silence
and a moment held
home.intro: I photograph landscapes, portraits, and the street — chasing stillness within motion and detail within the wide frame.
home.aboutText: I work with natural light and minimal intervention in the frame. My goal is to keep the feeling of the moment intact in the photograph.
home.contactText: Open to shoots, exhibitions, and editorial work.

works.heading: Works
works.intro: Each series is its own story, captured over a distinct period of time.

about.heading: Akira Kurosawa
about.bio1: I'm a photographer based in Kyiv, specializing in landscape, portrait, and street photography. For over a decade I've been chasing frames where light becomes the main character.
about.bio2: My work has been published in several independent magazines and shown in group exhibitions across Ukraine. I collaborate with architecture studios, modeling agencies, and private clients.
about.bio3: I believe the best photograph is the one that doesn't look staged. That's why I avoid excessive direction and favor natural light instead.
about.philosophy1Text: Minimal artificial lighting, maximum attention to the time of day.
about.philosophy2Text: Minimal post-processing — preserving the mood of the original moment.
about.philosophy3Text: Looking for calm even in the most dynamic scenes.
about.equipmentText: I shoot on full-frame DSLR and mirrorless cameras with a set of prime lenses. Prints are made on archival matte paper.
